blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Procedural generation plays a key role in synthetic data creation and game development, offering greater controllability, editability, and diversity than static mesh representations. However, VLM-based code generation often produces relatively simple 3D assets, while sophisticated photorealistic procedural systems require extensive manual development. Existing VLM-guided procedural methods remain largely constrained by predefined factories and APIs, limiting their ability to create novel asset types. We introduce InfiniDream, a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. First, we propose Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation, which leverages existing procedural algorithms to create novel, photorealistic assets while preserving editability and seed-based diversity. Second, we develop an end-to-end text-to-world pipeline that combines semantic scene planning with Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement to construct large-scale 3D worlds with precise object placement, procedural population, and animation. Extensive evaluations on 100 object and 20 scene generation tasks demonstrate improvements across four perceptual metrics. Diversity analysis, ablation studies, and human preference evaluations further validate the effectiveness of our framework. Project page: https://yichuanh.github.io/infinidream-page/

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Procedural modeling encodes 3D content as executable rules, from L-systems ( 50 , 66 ) and shape grammars ( 97 , 60 ) to learned procedural shape and CAD programs ( 77 , 89 , 36 , 37 , 38 , 72 , 98 , 41 ) .
Advances in code generation ( 4 ) and tool use ( 75 , 109 ) now let language models synthesize editable 3D assets as Blender code ( 13 , 55 , 73 , 96 , 105 , 9 , 69 ) , other shape programs ( 114 , 39 , 94 , 49 ) , or CAD scripts for mechanical parts ( 2 , 93 , 74 , 57 ) .
Multimodal reasoning, retrieval augmentation ( 43 ) , and iterative visual feedback ( 2 , 93 , 94 , 49 ) further improve reconstruction, editing, and visual fidelity ( 29 , 110 , 24 , 96 ) .
Procedural material graphs are likewise generated or inferred from images ( 78 , 21 , 27 , 44 , 45 ) , whereas inverse procedural modeling fits predefined procedural generators to targets ( 85 , 91 , 81 , 63 , 118 ) and remains bounded by their categories.
Still, reliably synthesizing complex procedural geometry with rich geometric details and photorealistic appearance remains challenging.
Benchmarks for 3D code generation ( 19 , 96 , 13 , 2 , 20 , 107 , 52 ) assess executability, geometric fidelity, and the benefits of execution feedback ( 6 ) and agentic coding ( 106 ) .
However, 3DCodeBench ( 19 ) draws its procedural modeling categories from predefined Infinigen factories ( 70 , 71 ) , leaving procedural asset generation beyond these categories underexplored.

程序建模将3D内容编码为可执行规则,从L系统(50,66)和形状语法(97,60)到学习程序形状和CAD程序(77,89,36,37,38,72,98,41).
在代码生成(4)和工具使用(75,109)方面的进步,现在让语言模型将可编辑的3D资产合成Blender代码(13,55,73,96,105,9,69),其他形状程序(114,39,94,49),或机械部件的CAD脚本(2,93,74,57).

同样,从图像(78、21、27、44、45)中生成或推断出程序材料图,而反向程序模型则符合预定程序生成器对目标(85、91、81、63、118),并且仍受其类别的约束。
然而,可靠地合成复杂的程序几何学,具有丰富的几何细节和光现实主义外观,仍然是一项挑战。

然而,3DCode Bench(19)从预先定义的Infinigen工厂(70,71)中抽取其程序模型类别,使程序资产的产生超出了这些类别。

blocks.en:
Procedural content generation ( 80 , 25 , 76 ) has long produced noise-based terrains ( 64 , 61 ) and cities ( 62 ) , and now yields photorealistic natural and indoor scenes ( 70 , 71 , 69 ) , simulation-ready assets ( 40 ) , and houses for embodied AI ( 11 ) .
Language models have been leveraged for 3D scene planning, spatial reasoning, and executable scene construction ( 28 , 82 , 119 , 117 , 15 , 108 , 3 , 17 , 83 , 1 , 116 , 86 , 22 ) , and one line couples them with existing procedural generators through function orchestration, parameter adjustment, and composition of predefined procedural assets ( 82 , 119 , 67 , 117 , 115 , 53 , 87 , 54 ) .
Related approaches ( 28 , 110 , 117 ) also explore hierarchical generation ( 17 , 84 , 95 ) , iterative visual feedback ( 51 ) , physics-aware dynamic simulation ( 56 ) , and looping animation of static 3D scenes ( 103 ) .
However, methods restricted to orchestrating predefined procedural generators remain confined to their asset categories and parameter spaces, while semantically consistent and geometrically precise object placement in complex scenes remains challenging.
Another line of work builds large-scale worlds ( 23 , 92 ) from procedural layouts, retrieved assets ( 10 , 108 , 1 , 12 ) , generative 3D models ( 65 , 26 , 113 , 101 ) , and object-level composition ( 95 , 31 , 59 ) , expanding generatable content and enabling instance-level manipulation.
However, these approaches and neural scene generators ( 35 , 46 , 16 , 112 , 111 , 88 , 30 , 5 , 8 , 18 , 120 , 14 , 7 , 48 , 102 , 42 , 99 , 58 ) generally lack the reusable procedural structures and high-level parameters needed for procedural editing and seed-based geometric variation.
Orthogonally, recent work decouples explicit world states from generative video rendering ( 32 , 34 , 47 ) and benchmarks whether video models render what a program specifies ( 33 ) ; such systems still require an explicit world specification, which procedural world generation can supply.
InfiniDream addresses these gaps: it enables open-ended procedural asset generation beyond predefined factories and integrates it into scalable, fully procedural 3D world generation, while preserving procedural editability and seed-based diversity.

3D场景规划,空间推理,以及可执行场景构造等语言模型被利用(28,82,119,117,15,108,3,17,83,1,116,86,22),一行通过功能调节,参数调整,以及预定义程序资产的构成(82,119,67,117,115,53,87,54),将其与现有程序发生器配对.
相关方法(28,110,117)还探索了分级生成(17,84,95),迭代视觉反馈(51),物理意识动态模拟(56),静态3D场景循环动画(103).
然而,仅限于整理预先确定的程序生成器的方法仍然局限于其资产类别和参数空间,而将物体在复杂场景中位置的几何一致性和精确度仍然具有挑战性。
另一行工作从程序布局,检索资产(10,108,1,12),基因3D模型(65,26,113,101),以及对象级组成(95,31,59),构建了大规模的世界(23,92),扩展了可基因含量,实现了实例级操纵.
然而,这些方法以及神经场景发生器(35,46,16,112,111,88,30,5,8,18,120,14,7,48,102,42,99,58)一般缺乏程序编辑和种子几何变化所需的可重复使用的程序结构和高阶参数.
从正统角度来说,最近的工作将明确世界国家与基因视频渲染(32、34、47)以及视频模型是否实现程序规定(33)的基准脱钩;这种系统仍然需要明确的世界规格,程序世界生成可以提供这种规格。
InfiniDream解决了这些差距:它能够超越预先定义的工厂产生开放式的程序资产,并融入可扩展的,完全程序性的3D世界生成,同时保持程序编辑性和种子多样性.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We introduce InfiniDream , a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. Given a text prompt, our framework selects a suitable initial scene and employs a Director to produce a structured Scene Plan specifying asset requirements, semantic placement constraints, and motion. Our framework consists of two core components: Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation , which creates novel procedural assets through constrained editing, and Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement , which translates semantic constraints into precise 3D object placements. Finally, procedural asset pooling, terrain refinement, and animation enable diverse, large-scale world generation.

blocks.en: 3.1 Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 象征性地限制资产产生

blocks.en: Since directly providing a VLM with the entire Infinigen codebase often leads to imprecise editing (Fig. 3 ), we propose Symbolically Constrained Editing (SCE) , which extracts key code structures and explicit editing constraints, transforming a large procedural codebase into a manageable editing space (Fig. 4 ).

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Factory Mapping and Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 工厂测绘和检索

blocks.en: Given a text description and an optional reference image, the system retrieves the most relevant Infinigen factory and constructs a Factory Brief (Fig. 4 (A)). It contains a Code Structure Map identifying key functions and dependencies, an Editable Surface consisting of asset-specific modules dynamically identified through depth-limited dependency analysis, and Linked Infrastructure providing read-only access to shared low-level algorithms (e.g., node graphs) via symbolic links. Together, these components establish explicit code-level constraints that restrict editing while preserving the underlying procedural algorithms. Further implementation details are provided in Appendix 12 .

blocks.zh: 3.1.2 结构化规划和粗糙建筑

blocks.en: The Planner produces a structured Editing Plan specifying the editing strategy ( Strategy ), target locations ( Locate ), required modifications ( Edit ), dependencies ( Rely-on ), and potential risks ( Risks ), as shown in Fig. 4 (B). The plan also accounts for seed-dependent logic to preserve controllable procedural variation.
blocks.zh: 如图4(B)所示,规划人员编制结构化编辑计划,具体说明编辑战略(战略)、目标地点(地点)、所需修改(编辑)、依赖(Rely-on)和潜在风险(风险)。 该计划还考虑到依赖种子的逻辑,以保留可控制的程序变异.

blocks.en: We define three editing strategies: Tweak adjusts existing parameters and high-level logic; Create introduces new procedural functions; and Promote selectively extends editing permissions to protected modules when necessary. These strategies enable controlled expansion of the editing space.
blocks.zh: 我们确定了三项编辑战略: Tweak 调整现有参数和高层次逻辑; 创建引入新的程序功能; 必要时促进有选择地将编辑权限扩展到受保护模块. 这些策略使得编辑空间能够有控制的扩展.

blocks.en: The Coarse Constructor executes the Editing Plan under these constraints (Fig. 4 (C)), preserving the original factory entry points and function signatures to maintain compatibility with the population pipeline and random seed control. It reuses existing algorithms to construct a coarse procedural asset. SCE preserves seed-dependent randomness by adjusting sampling ranges rather than fixing parameters to match the reference image.
blocks.zh: 粗体建筑师在这些限制下执行编辑计划(图4(C)),保留原工厂入口和功能签名,以保持与人口管道和随机种子控制的一致性. 它重新使用现有的算法来构建粗糙的程序资产. SCE通过调整采样范围而不是固定参数以匹配参考图像来保存种子依赖随机性.

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Fine Refinement

As shown in Fig. 4 (D), the Reviser iteratively compares rendered results with the target description and reference image, identifying discrepancies in geometry, materials, and visual details. It then performs targeted code modifications within the established editing boundaries. A Selector identifies the best candidate across refinement iterations.
blocks.zh: 如图4(D)所示,审校人员迭代地将制作的结果与目标描述和参考图像进行比较,找出几何、材料和视觉细节的差异。 然后在既定的编辑界限内进行有针对性的代码修改. 选择者确定最佳候选人,包括各种精细迭代。

blocks.en: Through constrained editing and iterative refinement, SCE generates novel procedural assets while preserving procedural editability and seed-controlled diversity.
blocks.zh: 通过有限的编辑和迭代改进,常设专家委员会在保留程序编辑性和种子控制多样性的同时,产生新的程序资产。

blocks.en: To avoid repeated VLM-based coordinate prediction and costly render-based verification, we propose Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement, which translates the Director’s semantic constraints into candidate 3D positions (Fig. 5 (D)). blocks.en: Given the specified placement region, we discretize the camera’s image plane into a 2D grid and generate 3D candidate positions along the corresponding camera rays. blocks.en: We evaluate InfiniDream at both the object and scene levels, complemented by diversity experiments, ablation studies, and a user study.

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Protocol and Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价议定书和基线

blocks.en: We compare InfiniDream against five baselines: VLM (one-shot), VLM (harness), VIGA ( 110 ) , BlenderRAG ( 73 ) , and Infinigen ( 70 ) . Following 3DCodeBench ( 19 ) , we adopt its codebase for the two VLM baselines, evaluating single-turn code generation and iterative refinement with a native coding-agent harness. The remaining baselines represent visual-feedback refinement, retrieval-augmented generation, and original Infinigen factory outputs, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了InfiniDream与五个基线:VLM(一弹),VLM(harness),VIGA(110),BlenderRAG(73)和Infinigen(70). 在3DCode Bench(19)之后,我们采用其两个VLM基线的编码基础,评价单转码生成,并用本土编码剂牵引力进行迭代改进. 其余的基线分别是视觉反馈改进、检索增强生成和原始Infinigen工厂产出。

blocks.en: We compare large-scale world generation against VLM (harness), VIGA ( 110 ) , Infinigen ( 70 ) , and Code2Worlds ( 117 ) , representing agentic code generation, visual-feedback refinement, original procedural scene generation, and LLM-driven hierarchical procedural orchestration, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们比较大规模的世界代与VLM(harness),VIGA(110),Infinigen(70),和Code2Worlds(117),分别代表代理代码生成,视觉反馈改进,原始程序场景生成,LLM驱动的等级程序协调.

blocks.en: We use Claude Opus 4.8 for InfiniDream and all VLM-based baselines, with Blender 4.x for generation and rendering. We evaluate 100 object-level tasks across six categories and 20 scene-level tasks at resolutions of 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 and 960 × 540 960\times 540 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Claude Opus 4.8来进行InfiniDream和所有基于VLM的基线,其中Blender 4.x用于生成和渲染. 我们分别以1024×1024 1024\times 1024和960×540 960\times 540的分辨率评价了分六类的100项对象级任务和20项场景级任务.

blocks.en: We report CLIP ( 68 ) , SigLIP2 ( 90 ) , DINOv3 ( 79 ) , and ImageReward ( 104 ) . At the object level, CLIP, SigLIP2, and ImageReward are averaged over four fixed views ( 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} , 135 ∘ 135^{\circ} , 225 ∘ 225^{\circ} , and 315 ∘ 315^{\circ} ), while DINOv3 compares the front view against four held-out reference images, independently generated from the same text prompt, and reports the mean cosine similarity. We additionally report code executability. Scene-level metrics use each method’s primary camera view. For scene-level DINOv3, each method’s primary camera view is compared against a single per-prompt scene reference image, generated by Gemini 3 Pro Image from the same scene prompt as a photorealistic wide-angle photograph of the entire scene; the same reference is shared by all methods and is never provided to any method during generation. Further details are provided in the Appendix.

blocks.en: We compare InfiniDream with TRELLIS.2 ( 100 ) on 15 text prompts. For each prompt, InfiniDream generates five variations using different random seeds, while TRELLIS.2 uses five independently generated reference images. We measure semantic consistency using SigLIP2 and visual diversity using average pairwise DINOv2 feature distance.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented InfiniDream , a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. By combining Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation with semantic planning and deterministic placement, InfiniDream creates novel, photorealistic, and editable procedural assets and composes them into diverse, large-scale 3D worlds. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness at both the object and scene levels.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了InfiniDream,这是一个由VLM驱动的、供3D程序世界一代使用的框架。 InfiniDream通过将符号约束资产生成与语义规划和定型定位相结合,创建了新颖的,光现实主义的,可编辑的程序资产,并将其编成多样化的,大规模的3D世界. 广泛的实验证明了它在物体和场景两级的功效.

blocks.en: Our current animation pipeline relies on a predefined set of motion types. Future work could explore VLM-generated animation code to support more complex and customized motions. We also aim to extend InfiniDream to indoor environments with more complex spatial relationships and object interactions.
blocks.zh: 我们目前的动画管道 依赖于预设的一组运动类型。 今后的工作可以探索VLM生成的动画代码,以支持更复杂和定制的运动. 我们还旨在将InfiniDream扩展至空间关系和物体相互作用更为复杂的室内环境.

blocks.en: 15 Ablation Study Details
blocks.zh: 15 详细说明

blocks.en:
We evaluate four placement variants:
(1) w/o Grid Search removes discrete semantic
planning and grid-based placement, allowing the
Director to predict continuous 3D coordinates directly;
(2) w/o Anchoring replaces our seven anchoring
types with Infinigen’s original grounding mechanism;
(3) w/o Semantic Target removes semantic
surface constraints from grid search, allowing
placements on semantically inappropriate surfaces;
and (4) Agent (Placement) provides a VLM
agent with our generated 3D assets, the text prompt,
and the same selected coarse scene, allowing
autonomous placement without our placement pipeline.

我们评价四个放置变体:
(1) 网格搜索删除离散语义

主任直接预测连续3D坐标;

代理我们生成的三维资产,文本提示,
和相同选定的粗糙场景,允许

blocks.en:
For each object, we select the lowest 12% of sampled points and cluster them
into four contact regions using k-means. The lowest point in each region is
selected, and its vertical gap to the underlying terrain is computed via ray
casting. Contact Spread is defined as the difference between the maximum and
minimum gaps, capturing uneven grounding independently of terrain elevation.

对于每个对象,我们选择最低的12%的采样点并将其分组
使用 k 表示进入四个联系区域。 每个区域的最低点是
选择,它与基础地形的垂直差距通过射线计算
铸造。 接触扩展定义为最大值和最大值之间的差值。
最小差距,捕捉到不均匀的地面,独立于地形高度。

blocks.en:
Both contact metrics are computed only for surface-supported objects (rooted,
upright, tilted, conform, and afloat; afloat is measured against the water
surface); airborne and submerged objects are excluded, while the Unreadable
Rate covers all placed objects. Ground-contact Error uses the absolute gap, so
floating and penetration both count by magnitude. Objects whose contact rays
find no supporting surface, or that failed to populate, are excluded. P95 is
the nearest-rank 95th percentile of per-object values pooled across all
surface-supported requested-add objects in the 20 scenes. For Agent
(Placement) , anchoring types are inferred from the full-pipeline runs; objects
without a counterpart, and plant assets whose lowest vertices are foliage
rather than ground contacts, are excluded from its contact statistics.

blocks.en:
We conduct a forced-choice preference study on
10 object and 10 scene generation tasks.
For each object, participants are shown the text
prompt, a held-out reference image not provided to
any generation method, and front-view renders
( 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 ) from six methods:
InfiniDream, BlenderRAG, VIGA, VLM (one-shot),
VLM (harness), and Infinigen.
blocks.zh:
我们进行强制选择优先研究
10个对象和10个场景生成任务.
每个对象的参与者都显示文本
快速, 未向
任意生成方法,而前视图生成
(1024×1024 1024\times 1024) 从六种方法:
(一发)
VLM (harness),和因费尼根.

blocks.en:
For each scene, participants compare 5-second
orbit videos ( 854 × 480 854\times 480 ) from five methods:
InfiniDream, VIGA, VLM (harness), Code2Worlds,
and Infinigen. All results are presented without
cropping or background normalization.
blocks.zh:
每个场景,参与者比较5秒
轨道视频(854 × 480 854\times 480),来自五种方法:
InfiniDream, VIGA, VLM (harness), 代码2世界,
和英费尼根。 所有结果均不列报
裁剪或背景正常化。

blocks.en:
The object subset covers animals, marine life,
plants, and natural props, while the scene subset
spans seven distinct environment types.
blocks.zh:
物体子集包括动物,海洋生物,
植物和自然道具,而场景子集
跨七种不同的环境类型。

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 18 ,
all methods are anonymized, and both task order
and method positions are randomized independently
for each participant. Each task contains two
forced-choice questions evaluating semantic
alignment and visual quality.
blocks.zh:
如图18所示,
所有方法都是匿名的, 以及两个任务顺序
和方法位置独立随机化
每个参与者。 每项任务包含两项
评估语义的强迫选择问题
校对和视觉质量。

blocks.en:
For objects, participants select the result that
best matches the description and reference image,
and the result with the highest 3D quality.
For scenes, participants evaluate text alignment
and overall scene realism, considering object
placement, naturalness, and visual artifacts.
blocks.zh:
对于对象,参与者选择结果
最符合描述和参考图像,
和3D质量最高的结果。
就场景而言,与会者评价文本对齐
和整体场景现实主义,考虑对象
放置、自然和视觉文物。

both levels. We recruit 30 participants,
yielding 20 judgments per level per participant.
